name: LED bit-map diagnostic
description: Diagnostic only. Lights six spaced key bits (28, 32, 36, 40, 44, 48) in the SPI output buffer 0x20001E74 immediately before shift-out. Report which six keys light and their order. Flash alone (untick Polyphony v1.1). Not for musical use.

patches.note: force all key bits in the output buffer before SPI shift-out
